name: dilara-zincbank-ai-
description: BDD UI automation framework for ZincBank using Playwright, TypeScript, Cucumber, and Allure

scripts.test:headed: npm run clean && cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js
scripts.test:chromium: npm run clean && cross-env BROWSER=chromium cucumber-js
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean && cross-env BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js
scripts.test:webkit: npm run clean && cross-env BROWSER=webkit cucumber-js
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const p of ['allure-results','allure-report','test-results']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
